ctgov.note: All trials are COMPLETED or TERMINATED. Most recent (NCT06493578, repibresib P2b NSV) was TERMINATED 2025-07 after missing primary endpoint.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Repibresib (VYN201) Phase 2b trial in nonsegmental vitiligo (NCT06493578) was TERMINATED in July 2025 after failing primary endpoint; company seeking external partner. VYN202 Phase 1b trial in plaque psoriasis was TERMINATED in 2025 after FDA clinical hold (testicular toxicity in dogs); a non-clinical dog tox study is ongoing through Q4 2026 to remedy hold. VYNE entered Merger Agreement (Dec 2025, amended Jan 2026) with Yarrow Biosciences; post-merger company will rename to Yarrow Bioscience and focus on YB-101 (TSHR antibody for Graves Disease), an asset not currently held by VYNE. As of snapshot, VYNE has no active P1/P2/P3 trials of its own assets.
